description: Repairs r-sort-3b/create-lu: the one-INSERT-per-row loads into UQ and UQD used Database.Execute without options, so a refused row returned hr 0 (INSERT ... WHERE ID = 2 returned hr 0 while 2 is missing from the survivors) and only the absence of rows was visible. Asks, on a copy of fixture r-sort-3b-lu opened read/write: new tables UQ2 (unique index UX_K on K) and UQD2 (unique index UX_KD on K DESC), each (ID Long primary key, K TEXT(40)), filled by one INSERT..SELECT per ID of T (1 to 54) with dbFailOnError and DBEngine.Errors read after each; then the IDs that survive in each table and the refreshed index metadata of both.
